implementation_summary: Added 7 unclaimed Company OS modules to the owns_paths of 3 existing capsule seeds. The 4 company/workforce shared files (common.py, errors.py, __init__.py, __main__.py) went to company-workforce-employment; knowledge/__init__.py and knowledge/company_os/__init__.py went to company-knowledge-store; intelligence/__init__.py went to company-knowledge-capsules because the two natural owners (company-research-intelligence and company-research-operations) both have exact-match test assertions that prohibit additions to their owns_paths.
not_an_approval: READY FOR CEO APPROVAL is a request to be read, not an approval. Nothing here merges, deploys or publishes, and Company OS holds no capability to.
objective: Declare capsule ownership for the modules no capsule claims
